SKY-CAPTAIN — commands the clipper from open bridge, steady voice cutting through wind and engine-roar alike
AIR-MARSHAL — oversees entire regional fleet operations, impeccable coat, dispatches orders via aetheric telegraph from command-gondola
FIRST MATE — manages crew discipline and daily operations, clipboard in one hand, brass speaking-tube in the other
WING-COMMANDER — directs three corvettes in tight formation, reads flag signals instantly, repositions squadrons mid-engagement without flinching
MASTER GUNNER — calls broadside ranges across the gunnery deck, smoke-blackened fingers adjusting elevation on the port cannon
SKY-GUNSLINGER — freelance combat specialist hired per voyage, twin revolvers custom-fitted, scans the clouds for rival ships
NAVIGATOR — plots the course by star-chart and barometric needle, corrects heading every thirty minutes without being asked
CHIEF ENGINEER — keeps twin boilers at pressure, oil-dark apron, wrench in belt, listening for every unusual vibration
SKY-CARTOGRAPHER — marks new cloud-routes on brass-edged charts, monocle steamed from the ventilation shaft, quill never idle
BOARDING-PARTY LIEUTENANT — leads the grapple-and-swing onto enemy decks, sky-cutlass drawn, three scars and absolute forward momentum
DIRIGIBLE-COMMODORE — commands a convoy of heavy merchant dirigibles, adjudicates disputes between captains, speaks with measured deliberate authority
STEAM-MASTER — monitors pressure gauges and valve sequences, keeps the engine room running at peak efficiency under fire
DIPLOMAT-COURIER — carries sealed treaties between sky-ports, immaculate uniform despite the turbulence, fluent in four trade-languages
SKY-PIRATE QUARTERMASTER — divides captured cargo by crew-vote, settles disputes with brass-handled pistol resting visibly on the chart-table
CLOUD-READER — interprets weather formations and aetheric disturbances ahead, advises the captain on storm-windows and safe altitude corridors
PRIVATEER-CAPTAIN — holds a letter of marque, hunts rival-nation freighters legally, keeps the paperwork cleaner than her conscience
MASTER-AT-ARMS — oversees weapon stores, drills crew in close-quarters combat, inspects every pistol and cutlass before engagement
RIGGING-MASTER — commands the envelope-crew aloft, patches gas-cells mid-flight, barks orders over the howling upper-deck wind
SKY-SPY — travels under merchant cover, reads manifests for intelligence, vanishes into crowd the moment the gangway lowers
CANNON-MASTER — designs firing solutions for long-range bombardment, chalk equations on the gunnery-deck slate, calm as the calculation requires
CLOUD-BANDIT CHIEF — leads a raider-crew from a hidden canyon berth, flanking ambushes in fog, no mercy for slowness
FLEET-VICE-ADMIRAL — second in command of a national sky-fleet, coordinates logistics and battle-doctrine, gold braid heavy on her epaulettes
AETHERIC-MECHANIC — maintains the aetheric-communication arrays and lift-crystal systems, soldering iron always warm, her repairs always hold under pressure
SKY-SURGEON — treats wounds and pressure-sickness mid-flight, medical bag strapped tight, steady hands despite the gondola lurching in crosswinds
AERIAL-SMUGGLER — runs contraband between unsanctioned ports beneath official radar-altitude, false cargo manifests memorized, escape routes pre-planned before every run
